source_type: mixed retrospective and prospective comparative prognostic prediction study
extraction_limitations: No companion material was listed or supplied. The manuscript references many supplementary tables and figures; supplement-dependent numeric results and cohort details could not be independently reconciled.
Main-text performance reporting provides selected numeric exceptions and direction-of-effect summaries rather than complete metric tables; atoms do not invent unreported values from figure graphics.
The LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated clinical-AI prediction-performance or code-availability atom kind; these concepts are represented using existing atom kinds plus tags.

Several quantitative comparison atoms use the clinician-group median as QuantitativeResult.estimate and preserve the paired AI value in arms because the schema expects a single estimate while the manuscript reports paired performance medians.
